Changes: Code 39 locates complete guarded symbols in either scanline direction and accepts quiet runs clipped only at the physical image boundary. Interior quiet-zone, character-width and payload checks remain. Fixed nine-run normalization avoids temporary LINQ arrays. RequireValid now checks short payloads and validates and strips the checksum for the encoder-supported empty payload; optional checksum behavior remains unchanged.

NormalizerEquivalence.Scope: Actual previous/current private normalizers through isolated assembly contexts. Return value, pitch and successful pattern match in both directions. All 84 three-wide patterns at ten pitches and three ratios, plus 100000 seeded variable-length run lists. Failed output arrays are ignored by the production caller.

Scope: Twelve unchanged Code 39 positives from the main corpus and the same thirty-one negative image IDs with an explicit Code 39 hint. These are supplementary contract checks; they do not establish a general recognition or false-positive rate.
Limits: Both binaries receive identical hints, pixels, validation and allowances. The earlier binary reads fewer positive images, so latency ratios include different completed recognition work. Managed allocation excludes native costs; shared-host measurements do not establish portable speed, throughput or capacity. Every measured sample, warmup failure, completion and unexpected payload is retained; successful warmup samples are not retained.
WarmupRetentionClarification: PowerForge executes three warmups. Successful warmup samples are not retained; failed warmups and all measured samples are retained. This corrects descriptive retention wording only; outcomes, raw measurements, source identities and historical attribution are unchanged. Original historical wording remains in the preceding verification archives.
